Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  CMOS mixed signals VLSI design [ECE_4445]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                With neat diagram explain the mixed signal design blocks                                              (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Illustrate with example issues related with mixed signal design.                                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Explain the working of parasitic intensive switched capacitor integrator in sampling and integrate    (3)  
  mode.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Design a logic to generate two non-overlapping clock signals has state sequence of 01-10-11-00.       (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           With diagram explain the working of latched comparator. List the advantages.                          (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Discuss the method to eliminate input offset voltage in two stage CMOS comparator.                    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Find the number of input combinations, values for 1 LSB, and the full-scale voltage generated for a   (4)  
  $$3-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit DAC, assuming that Vref= 5 V.$$  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Determine the DNL for the 3-bit nonideal DAC whose transfer curve is shown in figure 3B. Assume       (3)  
  $$that Vref= 5 V and Ideal height=1LSB.$$  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)   Design a 3-bit Flash converter, listing the values of the voltages at each resistor tap, and draw the   (3)  
  transfer curve for Vin= 0 to 5 V. Assume Vref = 5 V. Construct a table listing the values of the  
  $$thermometer code and the output of the decoder for Vin =1.5V, 3.2V, and 4.7V.$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)        Design a 3-bit charge-scaling DAC and find the value of the output voltage for D2D1D0= 010 and          (4)  
  101. Assume that Vref= 5 V and C= 0.5 pF.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)   Explain the working of Type-II PLL with neat diagram.                                                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)   Explain how charge Pump helps the PFD(phase frequency detector) to stabilize the voltage in PLL         (3)  
  design  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)        Calculate the equivalent resistance of 5pF capacitance sampled at 100KHz clock frequency.               (4)  
  
  A)                                               Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)   A 5um/40nm MOSFET biased at 1mA exhibits a transconductance of 1/80 ohm . If the sheet                  (3)  
  resistance of the gate polysilicon is equal to 20ohm/square, what is the widest finger that the  
  structure can incorporate while ensuring that the gate thermal noise voltage is 1/4th of the gate  
  
  Page #2

referred channel thermal noise voltage?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)               Explain, how adding dummy fingers reduces the shallow trench isolation.                               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
